{{Quote|She's got a Hanx-Wargel SuperFlow II aboard and a Siep-Irol passive sensor antenna. Backup generators, Carbanti active sensor stack, and almost new aft deflector shields, local-made but nothing wrong with them.|Junkyard operator|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
'''''Nighthawk''''' was a [[B-7 light freighter]] bought by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in a junkyard on [[Jovan Station]] following [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress's]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], attack on [[Phindar Spaceport]].

Yoda, along with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy|Scout]] flew the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] to meet with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].
